messages:
zara (People Ops): Quick note on post-handback appeals: were opening a 48-hour formal appeals window starting now for any manager-requested rating reviews. This is NOT for informal questions  appeals must follow the form and include manager rationale + supporting evidence. :balance_scale:

liam (Eng Manager): Clarify: this is after employees received their handback, correct? Timeline question for EMEA folks.

zara (People Ops): Correct. Handback completed = start of appeal clock. Window = 48 hours from the moment the employee sees the handback. If the employee is in a different timezone, use the UTC timestamp recorded on the handback receipt.

liam (Eng Manager): Who can file an appeal? Manager only, or can ICs escalate directly?

noah (Manager): And if the manager is unavailable (LOA), what's the path?

tara (People Ops): Process: Manager-initiated appeals preferred. ICs may request a manager-filed appeal through their manager  we will not accept direct IC appeals without a manager confirmation. If manager is unavailable, a documented skip-level signoff is allowed but must include a 1-line justification and HR acknowledgement.

zara (People Ops): How to submit: https://internal.redwood.com/appeals-upload. Required filename and top-matter so our intake system routes properly:

```
Filename: APPEAL_<lastname>_<YYYYMMDD>_<mgrInit>.<ext>
Top-matter lines (first page): reviewer_name | manager_name | current_rating | requested_rating | handback_receipt | appeal_reason (max 200 words)
Example: APPEAL_Rodriguez_20260802_LB.pdf
Top-matter: reviewer_name: Rodriguez | manager_name: LB | current_rating: 3 | requested_rating: 4 | handback_receipt: hb-77aa-20260802T15:04:12Z | appeal_reason: new evidence from client success showing measurable impact
```
\nappeals-bot: appeal received: receipt 7c9f-aa22 for APPEAL_Rodriguez_20260802_LB.pdf  uploaded 2026-08-02T18:12:05Z (UTC)  queued for appeals committee triage.\n\nliam (Eng Manager): What counts as "new evidence"? Can we include peer feedback that was previously anonymized?

tara (People Ops): New evidence = material information not available to the calibration committee at the time of handback (e.g., post-handback client metrics, newly surfaced peer corroborations, or documented error in original packet). If you include peer quotes that were anonymized, include the manager confirmation that you reviewed originals. Sensitive PII must be redacted and noted in top-matter.

noah (Manager): Timeline for resolution? Our team needs to know when final ratings lock.

zara (People Ops): Appeals triage within 24 hours of receipt. Committee review schedule: daily short triage + weekly appeals panel meeting (Weds 14:00 PT) for any substantive rating-change requests. Final decision typically within 5 business days; we'll update the appeals dashboard with status: received -> triage -> committee_review -> decision.

liam (Eng Manager): If the appeal is granted and ratings change, do we recalc distribution buckets? Could that shift other teams?

tara (People Ops): Minor adjustments (single-digit changes) will be logged and may nudge distributions locally. We only trigger a company-level re-distribution if aggregate changed headcount > 3% or if appeals materially alter distribution shape. Any company-level recalculation will be communicated and published with anonymized rationale.

appeals-bot: appeal triage note: APPEAL_Rodriguez_20260802_LB.pdf  triage_status: accepted  triage_ts: 2026-08-02T19:01:10Z (UTC)  ticket: AP-2026-0815-334\n\nnoah (Manager): Edge case: what if the appeal requests a rating decrease (manager and IC agree rating should be lowered)? Is that allowed and does it affect comp processes?

zara (People Ops): Yes, downward edits can be requested but they are rare. If granted, they flow through the same pipeline and will inform comp and calibration artifacts. Compensation team is notified automatically when any rating changes post-handback. Note: compensation adjustments follow separate timelines and may require HR compensations approval.

liam (Eng Manager): One more: where are appeal artifacts stored and who can view them?

tara (People Ops): Appeal packets are stored in the secure HR bucket with role-based access. Managers for the affected employee, the appeals committee, and HR leads have access. For transparency we publish anonymized decision summaries visible to managers in the Review Console > appeals/history. Full packets remain restricted.

zara (People Ops): Final reminder: appeals are for substantive, documented corrections. Minor wording changes or phrasing tweaks are not grounds for a rating edit. If you have questions about whether something qualifies, DM @tara with a 2-line summary before filing. :handshake:
